## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 91a0422e59f2539cd42b4638d60bd964a442abdd

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** The fix commit `5534be1bc` only touches the test file `NewAccountFormControllerTest.java`, adding a stub `when(mockOrgDao.findByCommonName(eq(orgName))).thenReturn(mockOrg);` and changing `formBean.getOrg()` to return the same `orgName` constant. Since the fix is purely in test setup (no production code changed), the real bug must be a prior production change that the test wasn't updated for. I traced the history of `NewAccountFormController.java` (the class under test) with `git log --follow -p` to find where a call depending on `OrgsDao.findByCommonName` was introduced.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `91a0422e5` ("Rémi Desgrange", Sep 27 2019) modified `NewAccountFormController.java`'s `create()` method, adding:
```java
String orgName = orgDao.findByCommonName(account.getOrg()).getName();
```
and using `orgName` instead of `account.getOrg()` when sending notification emails. This line is executed unconditionally on this code path and immediately calls `.getName()` on whatever `findByCommonName` returns.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** I checked the test file as of that commit (and all the way up to the parent of the fix commit) and confirmed `mockOrgDao.findByCommonName(...)` was never stubbed:
```
git show 91a0422e5:...NewAccountFormControllerTest.java | grep findByCommonName  -> no match
git show 5534be1bc^:...NewAccountFormControllerTest.java | grep findByCommonName -> no match
```
Meanwhile, `configureFormBean()` (used by multiple tests exercising the full `create()` flow) sets `formBean.getOrg()` to a non-`"-"` value, so these tests do reach the new `orgDao.findByCommonName(...)` call. With Mockito's default behavior, an unstubbed method returning an object type yields `null`, so `.getName()` on that result throws a `NullPointerException` — a latent test break (and in production, a real NPE risk whenever `findByCommonName` doesn't find a matching org) introduced the moment `91a0422e5` added that dependency without a corresponding update to the test mocks or a null-check in production code.

The fix commit `5534be1bc` directly repairs this gap by stubbing `findByCommonName` to return a mock `Org`, which lines up exactly with the dependency introduced in `91a0422e5`.

**Uncertainty:** I'm confident this is the correct root cause based on the dependency trace and the exact match between what the fix adds and what the earlier commit introduced. I was not able to actually execute the test suite (sandbox blocks `mvn`/network) to empirically reproduce the NPE, so this conclusion rests on static analysis of the code/history rather than a running repro.
